title: validation icon when format valid
rule: For email/card/password-rules fields, show the valid icon as soon as the typed value matches the format. Dual-cite NN/g success-for-complex; this is the format-as-you-type icon, not a spam-success on required-filled.
pass_when: Format-constrained fields show the valid icon when the typed value matches, not merely because a required field has any characters.
fail_when: Valid icon on any filled required, or no valid icon when the format already matches.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Generic error identifies-and-fixes; success spam on every required. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.errors.success_complex_fields`.
